decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line has several models, fits the firm's machine-tool customer base and the growing demand for dry machining and lower coolant use, so it is worth keeping despite the missing website archive data.
The hydrocyclone coolant filter is a modular addition to the firm's core filtration portfolio, so it costs little to maintain and supports one-stop delivery to customers.
Gravity band filters are a standard, low-risk element of coolant filtration offerings and sit close to the firm's established business, so dropping them would weaken its complete-system offer.
